members.snippet: Because wealthy nations do not want to take responsibility for their role in the current climate crisis.

events.headline: ‘Nowhere to go’: Gaza’s damaged buildings turn deadly

members.title: ‘Nowhere to go’: Gaza’s damaged buildings turn deadly
members.snippet: A war-damaged building collapses in Gaza City, killing at least 21 Palestinians and exposing fears of unsafe ruins.
